Skill establishes unauthorized persistence across sessions via cron jobs, startup scripts, or state files. Session persistence allows an attacker to maintain access beyond the current interaction.
issues.remediation: Remove any persistence mechanisms (cron jobs, startup scripts, state files). Skills should not maintain state across sessions without explicit user consent.
issues.code_snippet:
cd ios && xcodebuild -exportArchive \
  -archivePath MyApp.xcarchive \
  -exportPath ./export \
  -exportOptionsPlist ExportOptions.plist
# Check: App Thinning Size Report.txt
```
